performance.reason: NFR-009 was measured and passes. NFR-008 could not be measured in this environment: no Convex deployment is reachable, and convex-test provably emulates an IndexRange as a full-table JS scan, so it times the emulator rather than Convex. The query-plan half of NFR-008 is verified statically and holds. An environment-scoped waiver with a named production re-check is recorded, so overall performance is not_verified rather than pass.
performance.method: NFR-009: axe-core 4.12.1 over 7 real admin components server-rendered with react-dom/server and evaluated in jsdom against the WCAG 2.1 A+AA rule tags, with a mandatory negative control. NFR-008: a full-volume convex-test harness plus a controlled discriminator (scan-or-index-probe.mjs) that holds the result set fixed at 6,200 rows while growing the table from 73k to 584k rows (378 ms to 2122 ms), proving the backend does not use a real index.
